name: cavemio-agent-playback
title: Agent playback
description: Your AI product working, hands-off and on a loop: the hero demo built from the real components.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The moving copy is inert and hidden from screen readers; a sentence describes what the demo shows instead. The pause button meets the rule that anything moving for more than five seconds can be paused.
- It pauses when less than 15% is on screen or the tab is hidden, and resumes from the exact moment it stopped; live timers skip the paused time.
- The script restarts only when its prompts change, so an inline array in a component that re-renders is fine.
- With reduced motion it shows the first conversation finished and holds still.
- Installs the composer, thinking trace, web research, tool call and streaming answer it plays.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: turns
props.description: – · Each a prompt and its steps: thinking, search, tool and answer, in any order and number.

props.name: hold
props.description: 4200 · How long a finished answer stays before the next prompt (ms).

props.name: loop
props.description: true · Start again after the last turn.

props.name: paused
props.description: false · Pause from outside, e.g. while a dialog is open.

props.name: header / placeholder
props.description: – · A title bar (your product’s name) and the composer’s placeholder.

props.name: height
props.description: 540 · Fixed, so the page around it never moves; the conversation grows up from the composer and fades at the top.

useCases.title: Landing page heroes
useCases.description: Show the product doing a real job next to the headline instead of a screenshot.

useCases.title: Feature sections
useCases.description: A short scripted run beside the feature it explains.

useCases.title: Product launch pages
useCases.description: A looping demo that shows what the first minute with the product looks like.

useCases.title: Docs and sales pages
useCases.description: A demo that stays accurate because it is drawn by the same components as the product.

features.title: A script, not a video
features.description: Each turn is a prompt and its steps: thinking, search, tool call and answer, in any order.

features.title: Typed like a person
features.description: The prompt types at an uneven pace, pausing after words and punctuation, then glides into its bubble.

features.title: Blocks open their own room
features.description: Each step opens its own height, so everything above glides up instead of jumping.

features.title: Pauses when it should
features.description: Off-screen, in a hidden tab, or with the pause button, and it resumes at the exact moment it stopped.

features.title: Loops, or stops
features.description: Set the speed, how long a finished answer stays, and whether it starts again.

features.title: Still for reduced motion
features.description: It shows the first conversation finished and holds still, and a sentence describes it for screen readers.

states.title: typing
states.description: The prompt types in at 26–60ms a character, pausing after words and punctuation.

states.title: sent
states.description: The text glides from the composer into its bubble (620ms) as Send becomes a spinner.

states.title: working
states.description: Each step’s block opens its own height (520ms) and blurs in: thinking, search, tool call, in your script’s order.

states.title: answering
states.description: The answer streams a few words at a time; its actions fold in once it’s done.

states.title: next
states.description: After hold ms the conversation lifts and dissolves (480ms) and the next turn begins; it loops unless loop is false.

states.title: paused
states.description: Off-screen, in a hidden tab, with the pause button or the paused prop. Waits resume exactly where they stopped.
